band.authority: KIE common rules rule 12; adopted as Skill 71's native authoring target by owner Decision 1 (2026-10-15), tightened to the strict production band by F18 (2026-11-07), superseding Amendment 6 Part C wherever the two conflict. The 80-to-below-95 warn-and-expand band of the 2026-10-05 owner rule was restored in the canonical policy on 2026-11-08, superseding F18's stricter floor.
band.semantics: OWNER BAND: 95 to 100 percent of the verified maximum PASSES; 80 to below 95 percent PASSES with a warn-and-expand warning naming the characters to ADD (owner rule 2026-10-05, restored in the canonical policy 2026-11-08); below 80 percent is a particularly clear hard failure; above the maximum FAILS. The integral lower bound is ceil(0.95 x verified maximum). An UNKNOWN maximum REFUSES a pass. Verbatim fields are exempt from the floor and keep only the ceiling. The verdict is rendered by the one canonical policy service (shared-utils/prompt_policy.py); this file records which maximum governs each route, never its own band arithmetic.

cap_status_semantics.NOT_PUBLISHED: Provenance: the maximum is recorded from provider documentation and is not owner-confirmed. Under F18 the strict band applies to the recorded maximum in full; cap status no longer carries overflow semantics.
cap_status_semantics.OWNER_CONFIRMED: Provenance: the maximum is owner-confirmed. Under F18 the strict band applies to the recorded maximum in full; cap status no longer carries overflow semantics.
cap_status_semantics.UNKNOWN: No maximum is recorded: the prompt cannot pass, and the 2,000-character tripwire remains the recorded short-prompt flag (FIX-PLAN C6).
cap_status_semantics.VERIFIED: Provenance: the maximum is verified. The strict band's ceiling is the maximum itself.

counting_convention: NFC-normalized, trimmed ONCE, Unicode code points including internal whitespace/newlines/punctuation; document fences, metadata and JSON escaping excluded (Image Guide v5; FIX-PLAN conflict N3). The canonical policy service (shared-utils/prompt_policy.py) counts, hashes and submits that SAME string; Skill 71 records its hash and never recounts.

default.source: No policy entry matched the model id. No maximum is verified, so no prompt can PASS; percent_of_max is recorded as null.

models.source: Owner ruling 2026-11-08: 20,000, READ from 66-kie-image/models.json owner_prompt_cap_chars (one source of truth: this file never hard-codes the number). Vendor 32,000 does not govern.

Skill 66: GPT Image 2 authoritative cap is 25,000, OWNER_CONFIRMED 2026-08-27. The shared enforcer's embedded table lists 20,000, which Skill 66 calls stale; the owner-confirmed value governs inside Skill 71 until Trevor rules otherwise (FIX-PLAN C8, Part C-rule 5). The divergence is also pinned in references/external-authorities.json. Under the strict band: floor 23,750 (95 percent), target 23,750-25,000.

Skill 66 records the Qwen class limit as 4.5K TOKENS. Token-limited models are checked in tokens, never converted to a fake character cap; this validator has no tokenizer, so no character maximum is verified and no prompt can PASS on this route. Character telemetry is still recorded.

purpose: Prompt-budget policy layer for Skill 71 (FIX-PLAN Amendment 6, Part C; length doctrine superseded by owner Decision 1, 2026-10-15, and tightened by F18, 2026-11-07). The strict band is Skill 71's native authoring target: author each prompt to 95 to 100 percent of the model's recorded maximum by genuine specification only; below 95 percent warns and expands down to 80 percent, and below 80 percent fails. This file records each model's maximum, the policy layer's operative numbers; cap_status is retained as provenance only and no longer carries overflow semantics.
tripwire_meaning: A complete prompt under tripwire_chars is flagged for manual element re-inspection by the reviewer, recorded in the review file. It is NOT an automatic failure and never converts a band failure into a pass. Basis: the guide's four measured complete teaching prompts run 9,475 to 9,906 characters; no complete prompt in this system has been observed below roughly 9,000.
